name: Shackleton Rim / Site 004
source: Kumari et al., Planetary Science Journal (2022); Site 004 89.78 S, 155.73 W
note: Representative published point, not an approved landing zone
point_note: Moved 54 m from the published point (89.78 S, 155.73 W) to the highest 5 m LOLA cell within 100 m. The published point sits in a hollow 10.5 m below this crest: nearby ground blocks the Sun and Earth in every direction, so it gets no sunlight and no Earth at all, which says more about one 5 m pixel than about the site. We applied this rule only to this site; the other two use their published points. Street View shows how much results change within a few hundred metres at every site.
context: Study site on the rim of Shackleton crater, from Kumari et al. (2022).
